draft.text: You came in because you fell off a ladder and hurt your right knee.
You have pain on the inside of your knee that gets worse when you bend or twist it.
You may have injured your knee when you fell, but we did not find any swelling, bruising, or instability.
You will keep using crutches to take pressure off your knee.
You will talk to your doctor about imaging results and next steps.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you fell off a ladder while changing a light bulb and hurt your right knee.
You have pain on the inside of your knee that gets worse when you bend or twist it.
You may have injured your knee, but we don't know the exact cause yet.
You will need imaging tests like X-rays or an MRI to check your knee.
You should use crutches to avoid putting pressure on your knee.
We will talk about the results and next steps when you see your doctor again.
